trap-negation-contrast.evidence: Full read of alg:markov-trace including the long large-A transfer-matrix note. No constructions from the ten categories (2 spaced dashes in 733 words). VERIFIED: the three Markov axioms as stated (cyclicity, tr_M(a sigma_n) = z tr_M(a), tr_M(1) = 1) are the standard characterisation; 'for n <= 9 the partition count is at most 30' is exactly p(9) = 30; the Markov parameter z is not given a value here, so the block carries no convention-C/D exposure.
trap-negation-contrast.notes: NOT A TRAP, reported separately, two items. (1) The edge-case note - 'closure of any braid containing a full twist Delta_n^2 in the centre acquires a factor q^{n(n-1)} from the central character' - is not right as a uniform scalar. I computed Delta_3^2 = (sigma_0 sigma_1)^3 in H_3(q) symbolically: it is a genuine six-term element, not q^6 times the identity. Being central it acts by a scalar on each Wedderburn block, but that scalar is lambda-dependent: q^{n(n-1)} = q^6 on the trivial rep (sigma_i -> q) and q^{-6} on the sign rep (sigma_i -> -q^-1). The claim holds for the trivial block only. (2) The codomain is given as R[q, q^-1], but the Markov parameter is a rational function of q under either convention (D: z = q^3/(q^2+1)), so bare tr_M lands in R(q); Laurent-polynomiality is a property of the normalised Jones invariant, not of the raw trace.
